09_annotate.name: annotate_tour
09_annotate.note: Covers 01..21 and 30_ai_unsent_question. Scenes 02_data_choice_load/stream come from the chooser in capture_refresh. Needs the isolated example cache (Annotate refuses otherwise); flag set is inferred from capture_refresh argparse, not from a stage receipt.

09_annotate.name: annotate_suggest
09_annotate.note: Scenes 19_labels_for_suggest, 20_suggestions, 21_judged only appear with the env var set; may be merged into annotate_tour by the integrator (record all with the env var set).

10_classify_cv.name: classify_cv_gui
10_classify_cv.note: gui_18_source_folder_choice only shows in the --classifier-family ml run; for cv the existing-split run is the one that picks the folder (see next entry). Unsure which of the two covers 24_batch_figure/23_batch_finished; both run them.

10_classify_cv.name: classify_cv_existing_split
10_classify_cv.note: From capture_classify_existing.py. <STAGE> is the integrator stage. The split must be produced first by the terminal run: python tools/tutorials/capture_classify_preparation.py --stage <STAGE> --source <STAGE>/annotate_fresh/example_data/plate1 --destination <STAGE>/classify_canonical_split_v2 (prepare_01..03 scenes, terminal capture, not host-mode).

10_classify_cv.name: classify_prepare_terminal
10_classify_cv.note: Terminal-only (capture_classify_preparation.py --inside); prepare_01..03 scenes. Not a capture_refresh run; capture list intentionally empty.

11_classify_ml.name: classify_ml
11_classify_ml.note: capture_refresh runs choose_existing_folder (18_source_folder_choice) and capture_classify_ml.bounded_settings for this family. 25_ml_figure_02 recorded by the run.

41_classify.name: classify_overview
41_classify.note: main_02/03/05_*_tooltip/06. main_00_home comes from the shared openings run. ml_*/cv_* scenes reuse recordings from the 10 and 11 runs.

12_map_barcodes.name: map_barcodes_tour
12_map_barcodes.note: Needs network for the SRA archive picker (gui_02). --barcode-reference-source defaults to ~/Documents/barcodes (must hold validated plain/reverse-complement pairs); pass it explicitly if the neutral account differs. gui_20_batch_settings/gui_23_batch_finished come from the --run part. Unsure whether --run and the tour are meant to be combined.

13_regression.name: regression_run
13_regression.note: README: use a fresh output root (stage) and run via run_neutral_capture.sh for the journal paths; CPU only. Covers 19_setting_*, 21_batch_running, 25_result_*, 26_detail_*.

15_image_umap.name: umap_run
15_image_umap.note: Covers 19_setting_*, batch scenes and capture_umap.record_explorer (25..28). Unsure whether --download exists for umap or the measurements come from a prior Measure stage.

16_activation.name: activation
16_activation.note: activation_evidence.prepare(stage) builds the 4-crop archive, model and reference; it may use the GPU for the oracle (pick_device). Saved-plot scenes (*_09_saved_batch_0_grid) need a separate run with --activation-saved-plots, not host-mode (external viewer).

21_model_compare.name: model_compare_gui
21_model_compare.note: gui_02_model_parameters. The api_* scenes are terminal captures (capture_model_compare_api.py --inside) on <STAGE>/model_compare_1507_inputs, not host-mode. gui_00_home from the shared openings run.

22_model_zoo.name: model_zoo_benchmark
22_model_zoo.note: Scenes 01b..11 and 03b/03c (needs network) and 09b..12 (uses <STAGE>/mask_src). Cellpose bind path and the --ro-bind target syntax are guesses: SOURCE=RELATIVE per run_native_capture; the app reads $SPACR_TUTORIAL_MODEL_DIRECTORY, so check which one the neutral account sees. Inputs under /mnt/firecuda2 must also be reachable (derived/cellpose_masks, derived/train_cellpose, test_datasets/spacr/tutorials/merged).

23_agreement.name: agreement
23_agreement.note: Hosted on the Annotate screen; agreement_demo.prepare(stage) builds the artificial three-pass database. No download.
